answer: The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The terrace assignment is published and gale records each panel. Shards are assigned from the zephyr graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4009 identities would post 3914 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
